name: job-apply-pro
description: Local-first job application workflow desktop app

scripts.backend:dev: python -m alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head && python -m uvicorn job_apply_pro.main:app --app-dir backend/src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --reload
scripts.backend:lint: python -m ruff check backend scripts/test_packaged_browser.py scripts/test_packaged_mail.py
scripts.backend:format:check: python -m ruff format --check backend scripts/test_packaged_browser.py scripts/test_packaged_mail.py
scripts.backend:typecheck: python -m mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml backend/src backend/tests scripts/test_packaged_browser.py scripts/test_packaged_mail.py
scripts.package:dir: pnpm package:backend && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @job-apply-pro/desktop package:dir
scripts.package:win: pnpm package:backend && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @job-apply-pro/desktop package:win
scripts.release:win: pnpm package:backend && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @job-apply-pro/desktop release:win
scripts.format: pnpm -r format && python -m ruff format backend
